verdict.rationale: Base44 documents in-app AI agents that work with your app's data: they update records, trigger workflows and connect to tools (docs-6, docs-43). It also supports integrations with LLM providers such as OpenAI and Claude (docs-49), so users could build data-driven AI features. However, nothing describes the product itself producing insights or suggestions from your data, and the Data page (docs-9) is just a table and record browser. missing for 10: explicit built-in AI analysis or insight generation over app data, proactive suggestions grounded in user data, documentation or hands-on corroboration of such a feature.
